values.features:
• EASY-TO-USE DISPLAY: Watch your workout progress in real-time with the 4-window display. View your time, distance, speed, and calories burned all at the same time. Use the integrated pedometer to track your steps during each exercise session.
• EXTREMELY PORTABLE: This running treadmill can be easily and securely folded flat with the included folding key. Take advantage of the low-profile design, which makes it easy to slide the machine under surfaces and move it from room to room.
• FOLDING TOOL: Turn the tool counterclockwise in the frame locks to fold the treadmill frame. After it is folded, use the treadmill key to secure the frame in place. Keep the tool handy by placing it in its dedicated slot at the base of the treadmill.
• PLAY YOUR TUNES: Connect your music device to the onboard 3.5mm headphone port to listen to music through the integrated speakers on the treadmill. Mount your favorite devices on the treadmill by using the convenient tablet holder.
• STURDY BUILD: This treadmill supports a maximum user weight of 220 lbs. Reduce impact on your joints as you walk or run when you strike against the shock-absorption-equipped running deck, compared to exercising on concrete or other hard surfaces.
• POWERFUL MOTOR: This machine is powered by a 2.5-peak horsepower motor that supports speeds from 0.6mph to 8mph. Change your speed in an instant with the on-console quick buttons.
• VERSATILE TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Two sets of transportation wheels allow you to move the treadmill forward, backward, left, and right when it’s folded flat. This makes it easier to move, position, and store the treadmill when it is not in use.

name: exercise mini bike

values.features:
• LOW IMPACT: This under desk elliptical is a great way to incorporate lower body movement without putting pressure on joints. Enjoy a 7-inch stride while you're seated at work.
• SMOOTH OPERATION: The Belt-drive mechanism and the 3.52lbs flywheel makes each stride simple.
• EASY TO STORE: Measuring 20.5 inches long and 10.5 inches tall, this under-desk elliptical is easy to store under a desk. Use the integrated handgrip to pick up the machine. Weighing just over 19lbs, you'll be able to move it anywhere.
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: Bump up the exercise intensity in a matter of seconds as you cycle through 8 levels of magnetic tension. Each level makes it progressively harder to complete a stride, which makes it where you can burn more calories.
• 2-IN-1 DESIGN: Switch up your exercise when you use this machine on a desk-level surface. Engage muscle groups in your upper body as you pedal forward with your arms.
• EASY-TO-READ DISPLAY: Track your activity data, such as speed, time, distance, and calories burned with the battery-powered exercise display.
• MANUAL OPERATION: With this machine, you're in control of your speed. There’s no need to be plugged into the wall to operate the machine.

name: BELT DRIVE INDOOR CYCLING BIKE

values.bearingSize: d17*D35*B10, d35*D11*B7.65 (need all bearing sizes if more than one)
values.features:
• STATIONARY EXERCISE BIKE: The sturdy steel frame, heavy 49 lb weighted flywheel, and 275 maximum user weight gives this bike a rock solid build that will keep it moving ride after ride. Easily move the indoor cycle from room to room with the front-mounted transportation wheels. Stay hydrated throughout your workout. This convenient bottle holder is built into the frame for easy access.
• RESISTANCE: Feel the hills throughout your ride. The cycle bike trainer features a resistance system that gives you the experience of a realistic, real-road feeling. The built-in pushdown emergency brake will bring the bike to an immediate stop. Make your workout more intense and burn more calories by cycling at a high resistance level.
• SILENT RIDE: Experience a smooth and quiet ride with the maintenance-free belt drive system which allows you to work out without interrupting your workout or anyone around you.
• CUSTOMIZABILITY: Adjust the seat vertically and horizontally. Handlebars move up and down to adapt to any user type. Inseam measures Min 31 in / Max 42 in. Designed to keep your feet in place, these pedals are built with toe cages. Make this bike your very own with total customizability.
• BOTTLE HOLDER: Stay hydrated throughout your workout. This convenient bottle holder is built into the frame for easy access
• ADJUSTABLE HANDLEBARS: 2-Way adjustable handlebars for fit and comfort.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Easily move this bike across your home with the built-in transportation wheels that are designed to roll across home surfaces.

name: Sunny Health & Fitness SF-B1709 Belt Drive Magnetic Indoor Cycling Bike

values.display: SPEED,AVG SPEED, MAX SPEED, CADENCE, AVG CADENCE, MAX CADENCE, DIST, TARGET DISTANCE, CAL, RACE, TIME, TARGET TIME
values.features:
• MAGNETIC BELT DRIVE RESISTANCE: The 13-level belt drive magnetic resistance system delivers quick and reliable changes to resistance. The magnetic resistance system provides a smooth responsive ride by increasing the magnetic field resistance over the flywheel. The low maintenance belt drive system results in a virtually silent and stable exercise bike experience.
• DIGITAL DISPLAY: The robust multifunctional digital display records speed, average speed, max speed, cadence/rpm, average cadence, max cadence, distance, calories, race, and time. Measure your cadence using the RPM function on the monitor
• AVERAGE CADENCE AND MAX CADENCE: Monitor your average and max cadence to meet your training goals as you move through the 13 levels belt drive magnetic resistance system. Track and maintain a preferred cadence at a wide range of speeds and resistance changes.
• ERGONOMIC PULSE SENSORS: To ensure that you workout out your specific needs, the SF-B1709 Indoor Cycle Bike comes equipped with ergonomically positioned pulse sensors that transmit your pulse rate to the digital monitor.
• BOTTLE HOLDER: Hydrate with ease during any point of your workout with the convenient drink holder. Proper hydration is critical to optimal performance during long intense rides.
• ADJUSTABLE SEAT AND HANDLEBARS: The four-way adjustable seat and handlebars paired with a maximum inseam range of 39 inches create a fully adaptable riding experience for users of different sizes.
• FOOT LEVELERS: A simple leveling system creates a steadfast riding experience. Simply turn the levelers to match the uneven floor areas to keep the cycle bike from wobbling.

name: Evolution Pro Magnetic Belt Drive Indoor Cycling Bike

values.features:
• 44 POUND FLYWHEEL: 44-pound heavy-duty flywheel ensures stability to avoid jolting while riding. Emergency push-down brake stops the wheel immediately for safety.
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE SYSTEM: Magnetic resistance is more technologically advanced than the strap resistance mechanism. When increasing the pedal resistance, the magnets move closer to the flywheel, creating tension. Magnetic resistance is virtually no maintenance and the tension any cyclist wants.
• BELT DRIVE: Belt Drive mechanism is smooth pedaling and silent. This system is low maintenance, doesn’t require oil, and lasts longer and is lighter than a chain drive.
• 330 POUND MAX USER WEIGHT: Heavy Duty and High Durability steel frame construction with up to 330 lbs. weight capacity.
• FULLY ADJUSTABLE SEAT: Move your seat fore/aft and up/down to properly fit your bike. The bike padded seat is completely adjustable for multiple bike riders in your home! Inseam: Min 29 in / Max 39 in.
• 4 WAY ADJUSTABLE HANDLEBARS: Custom fit handlebars move forward/backward and up/down. Custom sweat-resistant grips built for comfort to avoid any hand fatigue.
• ADJUSTABLE PEDAL STRAPS: Customizable caged pedals with straps ensure feet are secure in place keeping balance and comfort.
• SPACE SAVER: transportation wheels for easy storage and portability. Convenient bottle holder within arm’s reach. Adjustable Foot Levelers for stability of the machine to your floors.

values.features:
• INERTIA-READY FLYWHEEL: The large 40-pound flywheel is designed to store moving energy that keeps you pedaling consistently during your cycling workout. The onboard magnetic brakes can bring the wheel to a stop instantly.
• BELT-DRIVE MECHANISM: This bike has a durable belt-drive mechanism that is smooth and consistent, allowing you to focus more on your performance while you're on the bike.
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: The integrated magnetic resistance puts you in full control of your workout intensity. It delivers consistent performance that makes your workout easy when you want it, hard when you need it.
• PULSE-SENSING GRIPS: Monitor your cardiovascular performance with the built-in pulse-sensing grips so you can actively check your workout progress, displayed on the performance monitor.
• DUMBBELL HOLDER: Use this cycling exercise bike in tandem with dumbbells (not included) to engage muscles in your upper body and core while you cycle. You can place them onto the built-in dumbbell holders when they are not in use (up to 20b).
• BUILT FOR COMFORT: Customize the bike to your height with the 4-way adjustable seat and 2-way adjustable handlebars. Maximize your cycling stability when you place your feet in the toe cages or on the clipless style pedals.
• WORKOUT ANALYSIS: Monitor your workout efficiency when you track your average and max speed and cadence on the built-in performance monitor. Use the speed and cadence data to assess and analyze your general fitness progress or cycling performance.
• MEASURE THE DISTANCE: Accurately calculate your personal cycling distance in both miles and kilometers to track a variety of different training and race distances.
• PRESET WORKOUTS: Take advantage of 3 preset workout modes to help you reach your cardiovascular goals through challenging time, distance, pace, and calorie-based intervals. Each preset will help you evaluate your progress.

• ERGONOMIC GRIPS: Built for comfort, find your favorite way to cycle on this bike. The multi-grip handlebar is great for vigorous climbing workouts or cool-down rides.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: The front-mounted transportation wheels make moving the bike easy and convenient around your house for easy storage. Just tilt the bike forward and roll.

values.features:
• 4-WAY ADJUSTABILITY: We crafted this indoor cycling bike around you. Take advantage of the bike seat and multi-grip handlebars that are designed to go up, down, backward, and forward. This bike can accommodate a variety of riders (leg inseam 29 inches to 39 inches)
• BELT-DRIVE: Enjoy a smooth, silent, and dependable machine that can drive the 44-pound flywheel. The belt drive requires little maintenance and will allow you to focus more on riding and less on maintenance.
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: This cadence bike has consistent and precise resistance that you can control with a turn of a knob. Magnetic resistance is contactless and requires virtually no maintenance. Press on the micro-adjustment knob to bring the flywheel to an instant stop.
• SECURE PEDALS: you can secure your feet by sliding them into the universal toe cages, or by connecting your clip-in compatible footwear to the bike. Monitor the speed of your pedal rotations with the built-in cadence sensor.
• PERFORMANCE MONITOR: Track your essential performance data on one screen, including speed, cadence, distance (in miles or kilometers), calories, time, and pulse. Take advantage of three preset workout modes to help you reach your cardiovascular goals.
• PULSE SENSORS: Maximize your cardiovascular workouts when you grip the convenient pulse sensors that are integrated into the handlebars. Easily view your pulse in real-time when viewing the beats per minute measurement on the digital monitor: speed, cadence, distance (in miles or kilometers), calories, time, and pulse. Take advantage of three preset workout modes to help you reach your cardiovascular goals.
• DEVICE HOLDER: Control your in-workout entertainment when you place your favorite personal device on the large tablet holder. Watch your favorite videos or listen to music on one secure hub.
• BOTTLE HOLDER: Keep cool when you’re working out by placing a hydrating beverage in the onboard bottle holder on the magnetic cycle bike.
• STABILITY: This magnetic belt drive bike is designed to keep you leveled throughout your entire ride. Take advantage of the unique tube system and the adaptable floor levelers that help maintain stability during your workout.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: After you workout, use the transportation wheels to glide the indoor magnetic cycling bike from room to room.

name: Stride Zone Elliptical

values.features: • SMART RESISTANCE: Computer-controlled magnetic resistance uses your heart rate reading to ensure that you're exercising within the optimal heart rate range to meet your goals. If your pulse is too high, the computer will lower the resistance to bring you back in range. If your pulse is too low, resistance will be increased. When unplugged, this power-saving elliptical exercise machine will allow you to work out at the last computer-controlled resistance setting used. • 20 INCH STRIDE LENGTH: Open your stride as you move through 20 inches of fluid gait motion. The increased stride length increases the joined range of motion and muscular stretch to stimulate larger muscle action. • PRE-LOADED PROGRAMS: Select one of 12 pre-loaded programs that provide a variety of training intensities to help you chose the right program to fit your goals. • WORKOUT MODES: With 7 basic workout modes, this magnetic elliptical can help you train specifically for watt output, target heart rate, or heart rate control. Use the manual mode to control variables of your choice. • PULSE MONITOR: Check your pulse rate safely at any moment during your workout with the centrally located pulse sensors. • EASY STORAGE: Front positioned transportation wheels and a large rear handlebar make this elliptical cross trainer easy to move about your living or workout space when not in use. • BOTTLE HOLDER: Holding your drinks is easy on this elliptical. Place your favorite workout beverage into the convenient bottle holder before your workout. • DEVICE HOLDER: Be in control of your workout entertainment when you place your favorite multimedia device on the built-in tablet holder.

name: Obsidian Surge 500 m Water Rower

values.display: Time/Distance / CALORIES / Stokers/ TOTAL STROKES / PULSE /Recovery/ CALENDAR/ TEMPERATURE/ CLOCK/HRC
values.features:
• WATER PERFORMANCE: Row on the water in the comfort of your home. The water creates a smooth and steady rowing experience with every stroke. Instant resistance is available with the flywheel and 16 fan blades. The faster the fan blades spin the higher resistance and dynamic response caused by the harmonious interaction with the water, giving the user a unique experience.
• DESIGN: Constructed with LIGHTWEIGHT sturdy steel, for solid performance and durability. The 16 Hydro Blades mimic the dynamic movements of competitive rowing. Non- slip HD Handlebar is sweat-resistant and wide enough to accommodate different hand widths. A tear-resistant mesh belt withstands the stress of repeated pulling. Keep the rower sturdy and level with the adjustable leveling end caps.
• ERGO-EFFICIENT: Molded padded seat is designed to be comfortable and functional. The high-profile seat design is 17 inches from the ground, which allows user to get on and off the seat without bending and straining you back. • COMPACT & FOLDABLE DESIGN- The climber strider features minimalist design that's perfect for space conservation. Its slender profile and lightweight construction are complemented by a foldable feature for effortless storage and space optimization.
• READY OUT OF THE BOX- The exercise stepper arrives at your doorstep fully assembled, offering the ultimate convenience. Its design caters to immediate use, eliminating the hassle of complex setup processes.
• SAFE AND MOBILE DESIGN- The max climber is fitted with non-slip, secure pedals and stabilizers for a safe exercise experience, alongside built-in transportation wheels for effortless mobility and easy repositioning within your space.
• Sunny Health & Fitness Commitment- A top fitness brand for 20+ years, offers superior products and a dedication to excellence. Count on our committed customer service and enjoy peace of mind with a 1-year warranty on the structural frame.

name: Adjustable Curved Climber

values.features: 1. Curved Climbing Motion – Simulates a natural stair-climbing or uphill climbing movement for an effective lower-body workout. 2. Compact & Sturdy Frame – Designed for enhanced stability and ideal for home use. 3. Easy Adjustment System – Enlarged adjustment knob allows for convenient adjustments for the incline angle, while the 4-level incline settings support personalized workouts and varying exercise intensity.The handlebars will follow the incline adjustment accordingly. 4. Enhanced Stride & Track Design – Large-arc tracks better align with the user’s natural movement path, while the extended stride design provides more exercise options and maximizes muscle engagement. 5. LCD Monitor with Smart Features – Tracks time, count, calories burned, total count, and SPM (steps per minute). Equipped with Bluetooth connectivity and wireless heart rate monitoring. 6. Transport Wheels – Built-in wheels allow for easy movement and repositioning of the equipment. 7. Heavy-Duty Construction – Features a sturdy tripod-style frame with a maximum user weight capacity of 330 lbs.

values.features:
• Bluetooth Connectivity for Enhanced Workouts: Connect your treadmill to compatible devices using the built-in Bluetooth feature and unlock World Tours with the SunnyFit App. Sync your progress, track your goals, and access over 1000+ training videos and immersive audio experiences for a truly engaging workout session.
• Wide Running Surface for Comfortable Strides: Experience a wider and more comfortable running session with the treadmill's spacious 20-inch running surface. Stand out from other compact treadmills and enjoy ample space to move.
• Convenient Handlebar Controls and Quick Speed Buttons: Stay focused and in control throughout your workout with the treadmill's easy-to-use handlebar controls. Adjust speed and settings seamlessly, without disrupting your exercise routine. Take advantage of the quick speed buttons for instant intensity adjustments with a simple touch.
• Joint-Friendly Shock Absorption: Prioritize joint protection with the treadmill's advanced shock absorption technology. Reduce the impact on your joints while running, ensuring a comfortable and safe workout experience
• Robust Frame and Stability: Designed with a rock-solid frame, the treadmill delivers unparalleled stability, providing you with a secure and confident workout experience. No matter how intense your training gets, you can rely on the steadfast foundation to keep you balanced and supported throughout your fitness journey.
• Diverse Workout Programs for Varied Fitness Goals: Achieve your fitness targets with ease using the treadmill's 12 preset programs and 3 customizable programs. Enjoy a wide range of workout options designed to cater to different fitness levels and goals, ensuring you stay challenged and engaged.
• Real-Time Feedback with Digital Monitor: Stay informed and motivated during your workout with the treadmill's digital monitor. Get real-time feedback on essential workout metrics such as time, distance, speed, and calories burned, allowing you to track your progress and stay motivated. Pulse sensors integrated into the handlebars enable you to monitor your heart rate during workouts.
• Secure Device Holder with Convenient USB Charging: Keep your tablet or phone securely in place with the treadmill's device holder. Stay entertained by watching videos or following workout apps for added motivation. Plus, conveniently charge your devices while you exercise using the built-in USB port, ensuring they're ready for use afterward.
• Easy and Space-Saving Storage: With its foldable design, the treadmill can be effortlessly folded and stored in a compact space within minutes. Perfect for those with limited room or for keeping your treadmill conveniently out of the way when not in us.

values.features:
• 【INTENSE FULL-BODY SQUATS】Designed for precision, the Row-N-Ride PRO incorporates resistance bands and an innovative design to amplify your squat exercises, activating both your glutes and arms for an effective total-body workout.
• 【MULTI-PURPOSE EXERCISE MACHINE】This squat machine offers much more than squats; it also facilitates deadlifts, incline chest presses, and bent-over rows, making it an all-in-one solution for your workout needs in a compact design.
• 【FREE CONNECTED APP】Access the SunnyFit App for free! Explore 1,000+ trainer-led workouts, 10,000+ scenic tours, track your progress, challenge others, and more. No membership fees, just fitness.
• 【ADVANCED DIGITAL MONITOR】Track your progress effortlessly with the LCD screen displaying calories burned, workout duration, reps per minute, and total count, keeping you aligned with your goals.
• 【12 HYDRAULIC RESISTANCE LEVELS】Personalize your fitness routine with 12 adjustable resistance settings, giving you the ability to control intensity and gradually increase challenges for maximum results.
• 【DURABLE 300 LB USER CAPACITY】Built to endure intense training sessions, this high-quality machine features a long-lasting frame, providing the reliability you need as you conquer your fitness challenges.
• 【ERGONOMIC COMFORT & FIT】Discover your ideal comfort level with an adjustable seat and ergonomically designed curved handles that come with four length settings, ensuring a tailored grip that improves your workout performance.
• 【RESISTANCE BANDS INCLUDED】Enhance your squats and target your upper, lower, and abdominal muscles with the included resistance bands for a complete total-body workout.
• 【COMPACT STORAGE】Perfectly suited for small environments like apartments or offices, this rowing machine offers both convenience and reliable performance, helping you make the most of your workout space.
• 【PREMIER U.S.-BASED BRAND】With 20+ years of excellence, Sunny Health & Fitness delivers top-notch equipment dedicated to excellence. With our devoted support team and certified trainers enjoy an unmatched FIT FOR EVERYONE experience.

name: CORE FIT HEX STYLE DUMBBELLS 10 - POUND(PAIR)

values.features:
• FITNESS APP EXPERIENCE: Download our app and join the SunnyFit® App community to access an array of free, professional trainer-led strength workouts and hundreds of other fitness programs. In the app, track your progress, set fitness goals, access personalized workout plans, and compete with other community members to get to the top of the leaderboard. Have any workout of your choice right at your fingertips, while also feeling supported and inspired as a member of this like-minded community.
• CHROME FINISHED HANDLE: The corrosion-resistant chrome finished handle provides a sleek look and minimizes dumbbell wear and tear.
• COMFORTABLE GRIP: The diamond knurled and ergonomic handle creates a secure grip, reducing the likelihood of the weights slipping during exercise. Avoid blisters and discomfort during your workouts with this textured and contoured grip.
• SUITABLE FOR ALL FITNESS LEVELS: With a variety of weight options to choose from (5 to 50 lbs), the Fitness Core Hex dumbbells are suitable for beginners and advanced exercisers alike. They can also be used for various exercises, from basic strength training to complex movements.
• SAFETY: The hexagonal-shaped weight plates provide stability, so your weights won’t roll when set on the ground. This is ideal for safety when not in use, but also for dumbbell exercises that require you to place your body weight over the dumbbells.
• FUNCTIONAL TRAINING: Dumbbells are a great functional training tool that allows you to add versatility to your training program. Work on improving balance and flexibility, as dumbbells require greater stabilization and allow for larger ranges of motion. Access a wide range of exercises that target multiple muscle groups to improve strength and muscle mass.
• SPACE SAVING: With compact dimensions, the dumbbells have a modest footprint, making them easily storable and designed to fit in living spaces of all sizes.

values.features: • POWERFUL RESISTANCE: Challenge yourself with 16 levels of programmable magnetic resistance when you power on this elliptical machine. Complete smooth strides as you engage the internal, 13.2-pound flywheel and the belt-drive mechanism. • PERFORMANCE MONITOR: Use the onboard, back-lit display to track your speed, time, distance, calories burned, rotations per minute, watt generations, and magnetic resistance level. • WEIGHT CAPACITY: This machine is designed to be stable during challenging workouts. Take advantage of its 330 lbs weight capacity and its floor stabilizers, which will keep the elliptical steady. • STABILITY: Step onto the wide and textured footplates to secure your footing as you stride. Hold onto the large handgrips for added stability and to engage your upper body during your exercise. • TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Move this elliptical from room to room with the front-loaded transportation wheels that can easily glide across ground surfaces. • POWERFUL WORKOUTS: Take advantage of 24 unique workout modes, including manual, pre-program, watt, body fat, heart rate, and user programs. • HEART RATE: Monitor your heart rate comfortably with the conveniently-located heart rate hand grips or an optional heart rate belt. Use heart rate info to start the recovery mode function after you complete a workout on this home-use elliptical. • COMPACT STRIDE: The 15.5-inch stride on this magnetic elliptical helps conserve elliptical space and elevate your stride for greater stimulation of lower-body muscles, including calf muscles.

values.display: Speed, Time, Distance, Calories, Pulse, Program, Mode
values.features:
• CONNECTED FITNESS- Bluetooth connectivity and get on track with expert-led workouts on SunnyFit® App. Choose from walking/running courses, access easily. See all workout stats right in the app.
• 3-LEVEL INCLINE & SUPERIOR STABILITY- Treadmill featuring 3 adjustable inclines for higher calorie burn. Enjoy stability and quality during runs, the double deck design provides structural support on its 16” surface.
• SPEED RANGE- Whether you're aiming for a gentle walk or a brisk run, this treadmill has you covered with a versatile speed range of 0.5 to 9 mph, catering to all fitness levels and workout intensities.
• LOW-IMPACT SHOCK ABSORBING- Enjoy running on a low-impact surface with the additionally padded double deck shock absorption technology. Protecting your joints will ensure the longevity of your training.
• EASY INSTALLATION- Designed with user convenience in mind, this treadmill can be easily set up in an average time of 20 minutes. Follow simple instructions to quickly assemble and start your fitness journey with no hassle.
• USER-FRIENDLY CONSOLE- The console shows Calories, Distance, Speed, Steps, Time. Track progress on SunnyFit app, connect with the community. User-centric design with spacious buttons, quick settings, handrail speed controls for ease.
• 275 LB WEIGHT CAPACITY- Heavy-duty treadmill built to withstand intense workouts. With a 275 LB weight capacity and sturdy construction, this machine provides unmatched stability for runners of all sizes.
• LIVE HEART RATE MONITOR- Monitor your workout in real-time with integrated pulse sensors in the handrails and SunnyFit App. Instant heart rate tracking keeps you updated on your performance and progress.
• EASY STORAGE & TRANSPORTATION WHEELS- The soft-drop system allows you to neatly tuck the treadmill away in any room. Transport it hassle-free using the tilt-and-roll feature - no heavy lifting required. Simply fold, grip the handlebars, tilt back, and roll the treadmill to your desired space.
• Sunny Health & Fitness Commitment- A top fitness brand for 20+ years, offers superior products and a dedication to excellence. Count on our committed customer service and trainers for the best fitness experience.

name: Windmill Air Magnetic Rower

values.display: Time, Time/500, Distance, Cycle, Calorie, Speed, Level, Pulse
values.features:
• ERGONOMIC DESIGN: Comfort and performance start with utility. The tall sitting position of the air magnetic rower allows for easy mounting and dismounting. Maintain stability as you row on the fitted rower seat.
• DUAL RESISTANCE: Some things are better together. Use air and magnetic resistance simultaneously to intensify your workout on the exercise rower. The resistance created by the fan is progressive, which means the harder you work, the harder the fan works for you.
• POWERFUL DISPLAY: Use the digital meter to track your workout performance. Manage your duration, distance, strokes, wattage, calories burned, and heart rate on one screen. Mounted to a pivoting arm, the display has several viewing angles to fit your workout style.
• CHALLENGING WORKOUTS: Use the different modes to power your workout. The rower has two high-intensity workout modes and one custom high-intensity mode. Utilize the goal mode to set time-, distance-, and calorie-based trials. The display can also show speed as a water wave that visualizes your performance with force curves.
• WIRELESS CONTROLS: Experience convenience at its best. Easily adjust the 10 levels of magnetic resistance with wireless handlebar controls.
• ADJUSTABLE FOOTPADS: Secure foot placement is key to force production. The ASUNA 8570 is equipped with a two-way adjustable footplate. Utilize the sliding heel pads to secure your heel and midfoot as you drive the rower. Tighten the adjustable foot straps to prevent slippage while you stroke.
• SELF-GENERATING POWER: Enjoy a powerful display with none of the plugs. Enjoy the patented self-generating mechanism that powers the internal display with every stroke. The efficient display conserves power after 10 seconds of inactivity.

【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】 Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

values.features:
• MADE FOR RUNNING: Dash up to 10 mph with comfort as your feet strike the cushioned, shock absorption-equipped running deck. The soft and responsive running belt (51.5L x 18W inches) absorbs impact on each step, which can reduce stress on your joints while you exercise.
• AUTOMATIC recline: Instantly increase workout intensity when you adjust the automatic recline. Boost recline from 0 to 15 levels with the quick buttons on the home-use treadmills.
• PULSE SENSORS: Be aware of your heart rate while you exercise with the conveniently located pulse grips. Grab onto them for near-instant feedback on the intensity of your workout.
• PERFORMANCE MONITOR: Track important workout data including your speed, distance, time, calories burned, pulse, and recline on the backlit, color display.
• CUSTOM PROGRAMS: Mix up your workout with 16 preset workouts, 3 user-customized workouts, and 3 countdown workouts. The cardio machine is also equipped with a BMI calculator.
• TABLET HOLDER: Add multimedia entertainment to your workout experience when you place a personal device on the integrated tablet holder. Charge your device with the onboard USB port, and play your favorite music through the included AUX cable.
• BLUETOOTH CAPABILITY: Play your music wirelessly through Bluetooth via the onboard speakers. Answer and deny phone calls when you work out using the on-console buttons. And hold phone conversations on the treadmill with the built-in microphone.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: After you work out, use the transportation wheels to easily push the portable treadmill across your home for easy storage.

• 【FULL BODY, LOW-IMPACT TRAINING】A full-body workout with our elliptical machine that's easy on the joints but hard on calories. Perfect for enhancing fitness levels, aiding in rehabilitation, boosting cardiovascular health, and firming muscles. 
• 【16” LONG STRIDE, 330LB CAPACITY】Achieve faster results with an extended 16" long stride on this elliptical. Built tough for a 330 LB capacity, it features oversized pedals for secure, comfortable exercise sessions.
• 【FREE FITNESS APP CONNECTION】Enjoy FREE access to the SunnyFit App with NO membership fees! Dive into 1,000+ trainer-led workouts, explore 10,000+ virtual scenic tours, track your progress, challenge others, and much more! 
• 【BUILT-IN PULSE SENSORS】Utilizing the Pulse & Heart Rate Sensors for real-time feedback. This feature helps with precise workout adjustments to stay in target zones & alerts you if your heart rate exceeds safe limits.
• 【WHISPER-QUIET & SMOOTH】The ultra-quiet and smooth ride with 15 levels of magnetic tension and a belt drive mechanism is ideally for home. Effortlessly switch intensity with a simple dial turn. Immerse yourself in tranquility with our elliptical.
• 【DURABILITY & RELIABILITY】Experience seamless workouts with our advanced elliptical, featuring a two-way 15.4 LB flywheel for smooth performance, sturdy design supporting up to 330 LB, and large, textured pedals for maximum comfort and control. 
• 【DIGITAL MONITOR, REAL-TIME FEEDBACK】Track various metrics by comprehensive dashboard. View your time, speed, distance, calories, heart rate, target heart rate, and odometer on the digital performance monitor. Train at your perfect intensity level every workout!
• 【CONVENIENCE & EASE】Enjoy effortless mobility with large transportation wheels, along with adjustable foot stabilizers for added stability. Stay hydrated with a built-in bottle holder, keep entertained or connected with a convenient device holder.
• 【SUNNY ASSEMBLY SUPPORT】Setup with our straightforward instructions, including a user manual, adjustment guide, and video tutorial. Sunny customer service is ready to assist! Focusing on your fitness goals right-away!
• 【20+ YEARS OF EXCELLENCE】Sunny Health & Fitness, a U.S.-based company, offers top-quality equipment with a commitment to excellence. Our dedicated U.S. customer service team and certified trainers ensure a truly unmatched FIT FOR EVERYONE experience.

name: Foam Roller

values.features:
【FIRM BY DESIGN FOR DEEPER PRESSURE】 Made from high-density EPP foam, this roller is intentionally hard—not soft or cushioned—so it can help transfer your body weight into focused pressure while resisting compression and staying supportive through each roll.
【12" & 18" FOR TARGETED MUSCLE WORK】 Choose the shorter sizes for more precise pressure on calves, arms, shoulders, feet, and smaller muscle areas. Their compact length also makes them easier to maneuver, carry, and store in smaller spaces.
【24" & 36" FOR MORE BODY COVERAGE】 Choose the 24" for a balance of targeted and broader rolling, or the 36" for the back, legs, and larger muscle groups. Longer lengths provide more surface area for smoother rolling with less repositioning.
【FULL-BODY RELIEF FOR TIRED, TIGHT MUSCLES】 Use the firm foam roller before or after activity for full-body stretching, mobility work, warmups, cooldowns, and everyday recovery to help ease tight areas and support more comfortable movement.
【DURABLE EPP FOAM THAT HOLDS ITS SHAPE】 Expanded polypropylene foam is lightweight, durable, and built to resist compression while maintaining the firm support needed for repeated rolling, stretching, and exercise.
【3 COLORS AVAILABLE IN EVERY SIZE】 Choose Black, Blue, or Pink to match your space or style, with all three color options available across the 12", 18", 24", and 36" foam roller sizes.
【FREE SUNNYFIT APP WORKOUTS】 Add more variety to your routine with free access to trainer-led workouts, yoga, stretching, mobility sessions, and other guided fitness content in the SunnyFit App.
【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

• FOAM GRIP: The foamed covered grip enhances comfort during your ab workouts to reduce blisters and calluses.

name: 2-in-1 Auto-Incline Walking & Running Treadmill

values.foldedDimensions: 63.9L x 26.4H x 7.7W (with tablet holder) // 61.8L x 26.4W x 5.9H (without tablet holder)
values.features:
【CONNECTED FITNESS】Via Bluetooth connectivity, this compact treadmill connects to the SunnyFit® app, granting access to an array of free workouts and fitness programs. Track your progress, set fitness goals, access personalized workout plans, and compete with other community members to get to the top of the leaderboard. Have all the workouts of your choice right at your fingertips, while also feeling supported as a member of this like-minded SunnyFit® community.
【UNDER DESK DESIGN】 Get your steps in while you work from home at your desk. This low profile, space-saving design allows you to store your treadmill out of the way, and easily underneath furniture, when not in use. Note: Handlebars Foldable.
【6-LEVEL AUTOMATIC INCLINE】 This hybrid walking treadmill boasts 6 preset incline options that automatically adjust with just the touch of a button. Easily customize each workout so you always take on the perfect level of challenge.
【DUAL MODE (WALK + RUN)】 With two modes (walk or run), this treadmill can be used without handles as a walking treadmill, with a speed range of 0.5 to 3.7 mph. With the handlebar unfolded and fully extended, the treadmill allows for running speeds of up to 6 mph.
【QUICK ASSEMBLY】This indoor treadmill arrives intact with minimal assembly. Simply unbox, unfold the treadmill deck from the console, and begin your workout. Convenient pre-assembly means you can save time, money, and energy when putting together this treadmill.
【TRACK YOUR PROGRESS】The large backlit LED display shows Calories, Distance, Speed, Steps, and Time. Easily keep track of your fitness progress at any moment during your workout.
【REMOTE CONTROL】Adjust your settings while you work out seamlessly. With all the controls in the palm of your hand, we make it easy for you to operate the machine without compromising your precious workout time.
【TRANSPORTATION WHEELS】 Built-in transportation wheels for easy portability. Simply tilt and roll out for use or away for storage, no need to lift.
【SMART REMINDER】This compact indoor treadmill is programmed to remind you when your treadmill needs more lubrication. Extend the lifespan of your treadmill, once the machine reaches 188 miles, an alarm will notify you to lubricate the running belt (lubricant oil comes included).
【FLOOR STABILIZERS】 Simply twist until level to maintain a stable and solid base as you row. This is essential for your safety, balance, and ease of mind.

name: Sunny Health & Fitness Upright Row-N-Ride™ Exerciser

values.features:
• WHY SQUAT: Squats are not only effective for building an insanely strong lower body, but also because they deliver a number of ancillary physical benefits, including increased hormone release and improved flexibility.
• HOW IT WORKS: Tone the lower body by using your glutes, quads, and hamstrings to push down to a squat. Work your shoulders, back, and chest as you push yourself up through every rep. Skip the weights, this squat trainer will reduce the amount of stress on the knees and joints that occurs when you squat incorrectly. Adding this to your workout will help you develop a proper form to get the perfect squat.
• TRACK YOUR FITNESS: The LCD monitor tracks your calories, scan, time, and count. This trainer gives you the freedom to add or remove tension, the three elastic bands can be clipped on or off the seat to adjust to any fitness level.
• WORKOUT VARIETY: Not only does it offer the ability to do a full-range squat but you can also add variety by doing high, median and low zone squats pulses.
• CONVENIENCE: Easily store almost anywhere in your home. Remove the knob, fold, and store; as easy as 1, 2, 3. Its self-leveling pedals help you to get in and out of the bike in a breeze. Stable end caps prevent any movement to ensure you have a stable and safe workout.
• ADJUSTABLE: Padded handle and saddle distance control adjust to your body length to develop the proper technique. Not only can you adjust the saddle proximity to the handlebar but it comes equipped with saddle angle control, which allows you to adjust the saddle at 30, 60, and 90 degrees giving you deeper squat positions.

name: Sunny Health & Fitness Belt Drive Indoor Cycling Bike

values.features:
• 44 POUND FLYWHEEL: 44-pound flywheel keeps the momentum of your legs moving forward as you pedal. Whether you ride hard or ride slow, you will always be in control of your workout.
• MICRO-TENSION RESISTANCE: To burn more calories and crank up your workout intensity, easily increase the bike’s step-less resistance adjustment knob. Various levels of tension give your legs the power to pedal intensely or give them a break with an easier workout.
• COMPLETELY ADJUSTABLE SEAT, HANDLEBARS, and PEDALS: The stationary cycling bike will completely adjust to fit your body. Adjust the seat up or down and forward or backward to ensure your body fits the pedals for a comfortable ride. For our taller riders, adjust the handlebars higher or lower and forward or backward to fit your arm length. Toe caged pedal straps are designed to grip and adjust to your shoe for a safe workout. (INSEAM: Min 27 / Max 35 inches.)
• SAFETY AND CONVENIENCE: Built for a great cardio workout, this home exercise bike allows you to quickly stop your workout at any time by pressing the emergency stop button. Bottle Holder within arm’s reach to keep you riding longer! Max User: 265 pounds.
• TRANSPORTABLE & ERGONOMIC: Bike trainer has been equipped with transportation wheels for easy portability. Foot Levelers ensure stability and balance for your bike while on the ground.
• SMOOTH BELT DRIVE: Stay in command of your workout with the exercise bike designed for maximum stability for a quiet and controlled workout. . The belt drive is low maintenance and is very smooth to encourage a longer workout.

name: Sunny Health & Fitness 44LBS Flywheel Belt Drive Commercial Indoor Cycling Bike

values.features:
• FRICTION RESISTANCE: With a twist of a knob, you can apply powerful friction resistance against the flywheel with the leather brake pad. Push down on the knob to activate the emergency brake, which will immediately bring the flywheel to a stop.
• 44-POUND FLYWHEEL: We've designed this training bike with a heavy flywheel for a smooth riding experience. During your dynamic cycling session, engage the flywheel with the belt-drive mechanism to gain momentum.
• ADJUSTABLE DESIGN: Tailor this cycle bike to your riding style. Move the seat up, down, forward, and backward for optimal seat positioning. Adjust the height of the multi-grip handlebars to fit your arm length.

name: Sunny Health & Fitness Total Body Bike

values.deviceHolder: YES, shelf on meter for phone
values.features:
• TOTAL BODY WORKOUT: The durable arm and leg resistance bands allow targeting of various muscles while maintaining a full range of motion. Tighten and tone your muscles while you enhance flexibility, strengthen your core and lose weight all with this full-body workout fitness machine. These multifunction resistance bands come with soft grip handles for a comfortable workout during repetitive movements.
• MAGNETIC EXERCISE BIKE: Build endurance customizing the adjustable resistance levels on the magnetic belt drive mechanism which keeps the stationary bike low maintenance and reliable. Adjustable pedal straps are included for added safety.
• SPACE SAVER DESIGN: The compact design allows you to fold and store your machine when you need extra space. The transportation wheels and folding capabilities of the total body fitness machine gives you control of your workout and in-home space!
• COMFORTABLE & ADJUSTABLE SEAT: Wide, padded seat holds up to 265 lbs. allowing for a comfortable and longer ride. The stationary bike is also built with a backrest for added support. Adjust the seat up and down for better proximity to the pedals.
• DIGITAL MONITOR: Effectively tracks your fitness progress with the easy-to-read multi-function digital monitor. Monitor your distance, speed, time, and heart rate to see how hard your working and have fun watching those calories burn off to keep you motivated.
• MULTI-FUNCTIONAL FITNESS: Designed for a workout that you can feel throughout your body, this amazing exercise machine is perfect when used correctly. Utilize the leg resistance bands found at the bottom of your bike. Strap your legs in to perform split squat stretches, leg extensions, and sidekicks. For an optimized cardio workout, crank up the resistance of your bike and pedal in high-intensity intervals. Use the resistance bands while pedaling to perform lateral pulls, lateral pull-downs, and bicep curls.

values.features:
• SIMPLIFIED MULTITASKING: The large detachable work surface (26.5x15.5x4 inch) provides a great place to set your laptop, documents, book, and tablet. The non-slip tray can hold up to 20 lb. A removable cup holder is convenient and out of the way to avoid accidental spills which could also be switched from the left and right-hand side.

• VARIED WORKOUT: With a simple twist, you can increase or decrease the 8-Level magnetic resistance (MTS) so your workout can remain challenging and effective throughout your productive day. • PORTABILITY: Fold into a compact, slim, space saving design! Store away in a closet, or in 'out-of-sight' spaces. This bike accommodates up to 220 pounds.

name: Sunny Health & Fitness Powersync Self-Powered Recumbent Bike

values.battery: Ni-MH rechargeable battery (This battery is special. It's in the chain cover, not in the meter.)
values.features:
• MAGNETIC TENSION: Modifying resistance on this in-home cardio machine is easy. Turn the resistance knob clockwise or counterclockwise to cycle through 24 levels of computer-controlled magnetic resistance.
• WORKOUT MODES: This magnetic recumbent bike is equipped with 12 workout presets that can build and maintain your cardiovascular endurance. Cycle through beginner, advance, and sporty modes to start an easy workout program or to test your cycling stamina.
• MUSIC CAPABILITIES: Connect your personal device to the stationary bike via the AUX input. Enjoy the ability to play your favorite songs through the built-in speakers.
• SELF-GENERATING POWER: Don't worry about cords or batteries. This recumbent exercise bike is entirely self-powered by consistent cycling. you can also use the cycling-generated energy to charge your favorite device via USB while you work out.
• TABLET HOLDER: Be in control of your workout entertainment when you place your tablet or smartphone on the device holder. Use it to watch your favorite workout videos, television shows, or play your music while you work out.
• PULSE GRIPS: This bike has two seat-level pulse sensors that are easy to grab while you work out. Use the data from the pulse sensor to gauge your current cardiovascular efficiency.
• COMFORTABLE DESIGN: Enjoy a wide bike seat that is made for long-lasting exercise sessions. The step-through design makes this easy to mount. Grab the ergonomic handlebars to keep your balance. Place your feet in the wide foot pedals that have straps for a secure fit.
• PERFORMANCE CONSOLE: Control the color performance monitor to track your time, speed, rotation per minute, distance (kilometers or miles), calories burned, pulse, and wattage. Use the resistance dial to precise control magnetic resistance.

name: Sunny Health & Fitness Full Motion Rowing Machine with Aluminum Slide Rail

values.features:
• ALUMINUM SLIDING RAIL: Superior quality railing offers smooth comfort as you propel your legs backward. The low-profile design keeps the rowing machine stable while offering a slight recline for a better leg workout. The smooth aluminum slide rail measures a length of 43 inches.

Ergo-dynamic foam grip handlebars extend with plenty of room to support full arm extensions thus providing a full range of motion.

• HYDRAULIC ADJUSTABLE RESISTANCE: Increase the intensity of your workout by adjusting 12 levels of adjustable resistance on the hydraulic cylinder. The pressure creates greater tension while rowing with the slip-resistant handles giving you better variety in your workout. The hydraulic cylinders help to create a silent rowing workout.
• LOW PROFILE: Low-profile design keeps the rowing machine stable, compact, and built for the toughest workouts. The product measures at 64L X 24W X 20H. (Inches) Max Weight 300 lbs.
• COMFORT AND SAFETY: Strap your feet in the large adjustable pedals with gripped texture for added stability. A comfortable seat offers extra padding while you enjoy longer exercise routines to keep you motivated. Front Stabilizers provide extra stability while you row to prevent slipping or moving.

values.display: Duration, Distance, Calories, Pedometer, Miles or Kilometers
values.features:
• DYNAMIC WORKOUTS: Mix up your exercise on your running machine with 15 levels of automatic recline (up to 14.5 degrees) and 36 preloaded workouts. Achieve your running goals on the large (55-inch x 19.7-inch) running deck with shock absorption—all powered by a 2.5-peak horsepower motor.

Use the recline quick buttons to adjust the recline levels to 3 percent, 6 percent, 9 percent, and 12 percent. Make even quicker adjustments to recline using the eco button on the running treadmill, which automatically increases or decreases the recline by 3 percentage points.
• SOFT-DROP TECHNOLOGY: The performance treadmill has a folding feature that allows it to be stored in tight spaces. When unfolding the treadmill, you can prevent unwanted slams and damage to flooring with the included hydraulic mechanism. The soft-drop system allows the treadmill to ease to the ground in a safe and hands-free fashion.
• TABLET HOLDER: Be in control of your in-workout entertainment by using your personal device on the secure phone and tablet holder that mounts just below the LCD. The large bracket holds most phones and tablets. Stay cool and hydrated during your workout on the recline treadmill by using the two large bottle holders.
